description: The deposit describes irrigated-area maps for India derived from MODIS observations for 2000–2015. The cited provider is Anukesh Krishnankutty Ambika; Vimal Mishra (via Figshare). The India maps cover 2000 to 2015 and use MODIS NDVI observations at 250 metres. Access starts from the cited provider page or document; no underlying files were retrieved. Listed formats are RAR. The inspected metadata names the CC BY 4.0 licence. The public information is free to read; underlying resource charges remain unverified. Reuse and continuing maintenance beyond the reported study or project are unverified. For infrastructure simulation, it can inform irrigation-demand or agricultural water-management scenarios.
